email_check.subject: Check your email address for Reliquary
email_check.body:
Hello {displayName},

To complete your account on Reliquary, open this link:

{link}

The link is valid for {hours} hours.

If you did not make an account on Reliquary, ignore this email.

password_reset.subject: Reset your Reliquary password
password_reset.body:
Hello {displayName},

To set a new password for Reliquary, open this link:

{link}

The link is valid for {hours} hours. After the reset, all your sessions stop.

If you did not ask for a new password, ignore this email. Your password does not change.

account_exists.subject: Your Reliquary account
account_exists.body:
Hello {displayName},

A person tried to make a new account on Reliquary with this email address. You already have an account with this address.

To sign in, open this link:

{link}

If you forgot your password, use the link "Forgot your password?" on the sign-in page.

If you did not try to make an account, ignore this email.
